mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_config_draft_approval (experiment_id, draft_version, base_config_version, approval_status, requested_by, draft_comment, approval_operator, approval_comment, approval_updated_at, approval_owners_snapshot, approval_required_count_snapshot, approval_policy_version) VALUES (#{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.draftVersion}, #{entity.baseConfigVersion}, #{entity.approvalStatus}, #{entity.requestedBy}, #{entity.draftComment}, #{entity.approvalOperator}, #{entity.approvalComment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{entity.approvalOwnersSnapshot}, #{entity.approvalRequiredCountSnapshot}, #{entity.approvalPolicyVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_config_version = VALUES(base_config_version), approval_status = VALUES(approval_status), requested_by = VALUES(requested_by), draft_comment = VALUES(draft_comment), approval_operator = VALUES(approval_operator), approval_comment = VALUES(approval_comment), approval_owners_snapshot = VALUES(approval_owners_snapshot), approval_required_count_snapshot = VALUES(approval_required_count_snapshot), approval_policy_version = VALUES(approval_policy_version), approval_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, experiment_id, draft_version, base_config_version, approval_status, requested_by, draft_comment, approval_operator, approval_comment, approval_updated_at, approval_owners_snapshot, approval_required_count_snapshot, approval_policy_version, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_config_draft_approval WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND draft_version = #{draftVersion}
